div.head: Leis Wl 21.1a
div.ab: E s'il n'ad guarant ne haimelborch e il ait les testimonies qu'il le achatad al marché le rei e qu'il ne set sun guarant ne sun plege vif ne mort, ceo jurrad od ses testimonies od plein serment; si perdera sun chatel, s'il testimonient qu'il heimelborch en prist.

And if he has neither warrantor nor surety but has witnesses that he bought it in the public market and that he does not know whether his warrantor or his pledge is alive or dead, he shall swear to this along with his witnesses with a simple oath. In this way he shall lose his goods (but escape punishment), if they bear witness that he obtained a surety for them.
